content:
Alternative to Ibuprofen(which I have found gives instant relieve to acute stress symptoms)?
45  
male  
1.94m  
104kg  
Caucasian  
I live in Northern Europe  
20 years of stress, been using Ibuprofen regularly for the last year or so  
Other relevant medical issues; anxiety/c-ptsd, adhd, ocd, Herpes; I regularly get sores in my mouth and nose and infection in my eye, mostly if I sleep badly for a couple of days.  
Medications; Metoprolol, for about 6 months, to lower my heart rate after exercising. Atomoxetin for 3 weeks now, Ibuprofen for about a year. 15mg Mirtazapin for my sleep issues, for about 6 months now.  
  
For the last 20 years I have suffered from stress. It has gotten worse and worse and for the last several years I've managed it daily. I don't have symptoms all the time, it mostly comes in relation to physical exertion, both from doing, for instance, yard work but also from exercise. Which means I am, in some way, affected by it most days.  
It manifests itself as physical symptoms; elevated heart rate ~110bpm instead of the usual 70, hyperventilation, and extreme bodily tension. When I have these acute symptoms I can't fall asleep. Approximately a year ago, by coincidence, I found that Ibuprofen more or less instantly removed these symptoms. Problem is, Ibuprofen is highly advised against using regularly.  
  
I am looking for advice for a substitute to Ibuprofen and perhaps also your thoughts on my case as a whole.
